en.name: Cult Leader
en.ability: Each night, you become the alignment of an alive neighbour. If all good players choose to join your cult, your team wins.
en.flavor: Thinking themselves wise, they became fools.

zh.name: 异教领袖
zh.ability: 每个夜晚，你会转变为与你邻近的一名存活的玩家的阵营。每个白天，你可以提议所有玩家加入你的教派，如果所有善良玩家同意加入，你的阵营获胜。
